text: Exhibition Place has a marketing alliance agreement between the Board and SMG Canada ULC (SMG Canada) dated December 1, 2014 (the "Marketing Agreement") which expires on December 31, 2018. On December 12, 2017, Exhibition Place received a letter from SMG advising that Onex Corporation ("Onex") would be acquiring full ownership of SMG Holdings Inc. including SMG Canada under a Merger Agreement. This report is seeking the Board’s approval for the assignment of the Agreement due to the change in ownership structure.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Consented to the assignment of the Marketing Agreement between SMG Canada ULC and the Board to Onex Corporation subject to entering into an Assignment Agreement with terms and conditions agreed to by the Chief Executive Officer and the City Solicitor.
